significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that LLMs contain “partially distinct representations for their own belief” and attributed belief, and that leakage between them causally produces false-belief attribution errors; this is a form-(ii) causal claim of the separable-channel plus ablation-repair shape, not a general law. It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon—attributed-belief readouts shifting toward own-belief values—and a mechanism that would explain the information-access errors measured behaviorally by FANToM (Kim et al., 2023), while predicting that early commitment to an answer should worsen the same failure; however, it remains bounded to belief attribution. Refutation would meaningfully rule out own-belief leakage as this error mechanism, although it would not distinguish among many alternative mechanisms, and the two branches are distinguishable despite acknowledged ambiguity in operationalizing “own belief.” In the topic-substitution check, generic research on LLM beliefs would merit only the topic median; the specific self/other causal decomposition supplies a modest increment rather than inheriting importance from the topic.

reach.justification: The named handles are a “leakage metric” and the intervention “own-belief subspace ablation”; the former is post hoc, whereas the latter acts ex ante at the attribution position before the model emits its answer and could therefore provide a limited action window. After re-extraction on another model, the conclusion predicts only that a useful self/other decomposition may be found, not its geometry, leakage magnitude, or intervention effect, so it transfers mainly as a procedure rather than as a quantitative relation. Although the hypothesis is phrased broadly over “LLMs,” its stated prompt sensitivity and restriction to false-belief attribution make the likely downstream users primarily theory-of-mind researchers and specialized auditors, with only narrow deployment uptake. Under topic substitution, “LLM beliefs” alone supplies neither of these handles, so the score comes from the specific diagnostic and inference-time intervention, but their model-specific character keeps reach near the topic median.
